summary: The reading of ZR 23-344(b) (the short dimension of a block) and 23-344(c)(3), read independently in step P7 by two AI helpers working alone from a sealed folder (the 189 pinned law captures without their notes; the block-7334 lot outlines; the DCM centrelines; the PLUTO rows of lots 70 and 1; the printed tax-map labels; the zoning of lot 70; ten made-up boundary cases M1 to M10; and four answers settled by earlier readings), with no access to the program, the repository or the web. It records the reading of what 23-344(b) measures and whether 'less than 230 feet' is strict and how 'within 100 feet of such street line' is measured; of 23-344(c) and (c)(3); of how 23-342, 23-343 and 23-344(a)/(b)/(c) fit together; the ten made-up cases; and the real lot (215-16 Northern Boulevard, lot 70 of block 7334) under Z1 (lot 70 alone) and Z2 (lots 70 and 1 together) on each measurement basis, plus the bounding streets, their widths and the ALLEY. A value or a yes/no is recorded only where both readings give it on the same facts, the same quoted words and the same basis; otherwise the row is not known or not settled, naming both readings, the kind of its gap (a missing fact about the property, or unresolved law) and what would settle it. Where both readings give the same answer but one holds it subject to a text the readers did not have (reading 2's question whether R6B falls within 'R6 through R12'), the answer and the condition are both recorded, naming the reading that raised it. No value comes from a program run; no unconditional 'no rear yard' is recorded for the real lot; no human verdict is entered. Every quantity carries exactly one of the nine measurement bases and no two bases are mixed in one figure.
what_it_is_worth: Read independently by two AI helpers, each working alone from the sealed step-P7 folder (reading 1 an official-source-researcher, reading 2 a data-contract-verifier); their agreement alone is not proof. It is a draft reading of the law by an AI helper, not professionally reviewed, and is not a statement that anything complies. A second AI read the same sealed folder and worked the same seven questions. Where the two readings differ, where one says not known, or where one holds an answer subject to a text the readers did not have, the row says so and names both readings; where the captured text does not settle a point the row says not known and names what would settle it. The real lot's rear-yard answers stay conditional on the measurement basis, the zoning lot and the neighbouring lots' records, which no reading had.
what_it_does_not_establish: It records a value or a yes/no only where both readings agree on the same basis; where they differ, where one says not known, or where one holds an answer subject to a text the readers did not have, the row says so and names both readings.

No row records an unconditional 'no rear yard' for the real lot: every real-lot conclusion names its conditions (the zoning lot, the measurement basis, the street line or point it is measured from) and quotes ZR 23-344; the corner test of 23-344(a) is never worded as the only exception.

The measurement basis for the short dimension of a block, the method of measuring 'within 100 feet', the treatment of the exact-100-ft edge, and the method for a non-rectangular block are unresolved in the captured text; the authoritative side-street separation, the zoning lot (Z1 vs Z2) and the neighbouring lots' lot-line kinds are facts neither reading had.

Every quantity carries exactly one of the nine measurement bases and no two bases are mixed in one figure; the made-up cases' dimensions are stated facts of a made-up block, not measurements of any property.
It is not a professional or legal determination and does not say anything complies; no human verdict is entered anywhere; agreement between two AI readings is not proof.

citations.title: Additional rear yard modifications (c)(1)
citations.quote: In all districts, a #rear yard# shall be provided in accordance with Section 23-342 (Rear yard requirements), where such #rear lot line# coincides with a #rear lot line# of an adjoining #zoning lot#.
